Add focused regression tests for pinch Canonical refresh, first-post-pinch handoff, and preserved multi-contact ink behavior.
Authorize the Windows qualification workflow to build and run the real Ink Playground viewport/handoff targets with locked Arc and Skia dependencies.
Materialize exact-result build, CTest, scope, and physical-verification input evidence.

No Windows D3D12/Skia provider or DirectComposition redesign.
No CanonicalVisible identity or Arc protocol redesign.
No Debug UI architecture or Undo/Redo changes.
